name: Cortello's Riddle
summary: A hidden parchment found aboard the Bloodsail Buccaneer vessels along the Wild Shore presents Cortello's cryptic verse. Deciphering the poem points travelers toward a clue waiting beneath an ornate bridge.

sections.title: A Buccaneer's Riddle
sections.body: Scattered notes aboard the Bloodsail fleet anchored off the southern coast of Stranglethorn Vale carry a rhyme. Cortello's verse describes a finely worked, much-used bridge that lies east of Deadwind and south of Redridge. Anyone seeking to unravel the mystery must follow these poetic directions out of the jungle and into the marshes to find what waits underneath.

sections.title: The Marsh Crossing
sections.body: Following the verse leads to the murky waters beneath an ornate bridge spanning the Swamp of Sorrows. Resting under the bridge lies a soggy parchment, waiting to reveal the next step in Cortello's puzzle.

faq.answer: The riddle begins with a scrap of parchment found around the Bloodsail Buccaneers' fleet at anchor off the Wild Shore, south of Booty Bay.

faq.q: What location is described in the riddle?
aliases: what bridge is in cortellos riddle
bridge east of deadwind south of redridge
faq.answer: The rhyme points to a well-traveled, ornate bridge located in the Swamp of Sorrows, situated east of Deadwind Pass and south of the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: What are you searching for beneath the bridge?
aliases: what do you find in swamp of sorrows
faq.answer: The riddle says something waits underneath the bridge, a hint or a clue that lies there for endless tomorrows.
The riddle goes by Cortello's name, though the parchment says nothing more about who he was.
